## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `ApiSecurity`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `api-security`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **ApiSecurity**.

## Step 2: Configure security for an integration as an API

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to the [WSO2 Cloud](https://console.devant.dev). -->
2. <!-- manual: Select your project and navigate to the Overview page in the left navigation. -->
3. <!-- manual: Select the integration as API you want to configure security for. -->
4. <!-- manual: In the integration Overview page, on the right side, click Configure Security. -->
5. In the **Configure Security** pane, select **Security Scheme** you want to use (API Key or OAuth2).
6. <!-- manual: With the API Key scheme, you can select Resource Level security for the API. By default, security is applied at the API level. -->
7. <!-- manual: With the OAuth2 scheme, in addition to Resource Level security configurations, you can also configure permissions for the API. You can select from the available scopes or create new ones, and then assign them to each resource. -->
8. <!-- manual: For unscoped resources, clients can use either an API Key or an OAuth2 access token to authenticate. -->
9. <!-- manual: For resources with OAuth2 scopes assigned (permissions), only OAuth2 authentication is permitted. -->
10. Select **Apply** to save the changes. The changes will be deployed to the Development environment immediately. For other environments, you need to promote the changes.
